text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...!!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thundering hoofbeats of the horsegirls 
echoed 
through the empty stands. That sheer sound 
alone proved 
the unbelievable power with which they 
surged forward.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Keep going...! Hold on, just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even whispers blurted out in moments of 
tension 
were effortlessly audible now. Ironically, 
this silence— 
bared the raw essence of racing for all to 
see.
choice_data_list:
(A horsegirl running at full throttle 
truly moves the heart—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Daring Tact— 
was giving every ounce of her soul right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I will win! I'll win... 
and bring smiles back to everyone back 
home!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Mud like this is nothing! 
The mountains of Erimo, the rains back 
home... 
are far, far harsher than this!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So—I will not lose!! 
Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haah... Haah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I won...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Tore-san...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No shouting was permitted. So, I clapped 
with all my might. 
Every single soul present shared the exact 
same feeling, 
praising the victor with their hands.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... 
Thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... it reached them, 
didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nodded back at Daring Tact's joyful 
smile. 
Without a doubt, it had reached them. 
Except... 
not just Hidaka—it had reached the entire 
world.

text_block_list.name: TV Spectator
text_block_list.text:
W-What...?! Wh-What was that late burst of 
speed...?!

text_block_list.name: Café Manager
text_block_list.text:
On heavy ground like that... 
how on earth could she run with such sheer 
power...?!

text_block_list.name: Social Media Posts
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact... I am in utter shock!" 
"Hold on, that strength... 
is she on Almond Eye's level or what?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Tact... oh, my goodness...! 
You never cease to amaze!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Under these conditions... such an 
unshakable victory.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Is that really the same girl 
I felt I had to cheer up...?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...No, she is the very same girl. 
Because Tact never puts on an act.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
She was always just being herself all 
along. 
I was simply blind to it...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Blind to the fact that she— 
is a natural-born star.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The redness in your hands has gone down. 
What a relief...
choice_data_list:
Thanks for wetting the handkerchief for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Still, I was quite startled. 
Your hands were bright red, Tore-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You were truly clapping 
with all your might, weren't you?
choice_data_list:
Since there were no cheers, I thought it 
was the least I could do.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
It made me extraordinarily happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her radiant, fulfilled smile, a 
thought crossed my mind. 
If only that victory could have been 
celebrated 
with so many more rounds of applause... 
how wonderful that would have been.
choice_data_list:
(Right... people can't travel right now, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The banner from the folks back home that I 
saw through my phone before the race... 
Maybe they could send that over to us.
choice_data_list: (I'll ask them about it next time.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Buzz... buzz...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Congratulations!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That was an incredible run! When are you 
getting back?! 
Let's celebrate right away! 
Ah, without causing a loud fuss, of 
course!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Epiphaneia, let me speak too...! 
—Tact, can you hear me?! 
Congratulations~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Both of you...! 
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—By the time we returned to the academy, 
night had completely fallen.
choice_data_list:
Our next target race is the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks).

Our next target race is the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
It's 2,400 meters... Quite a step up in 
distance...
choice_data_list: You'll be fine on distance. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distance wasn't a concern, but after 
today's race, 
she had vaulted straight to the favorite 
for this year's Triple Tiara. 
With all that spotlight—
choice_data_list:
The competition will be marking you much 
closer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will win. 
After all, I am going to become a Triple 
Tiara horsegirl.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's do this! Get plenty of rest 
tonight.

Yeah, let's do this! Get plenty of rest 
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. 
—Good night.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Tact, congratulations! Seriously! 
I couldn't help screaming down that final 
stretch!"

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"The whole town was doing the same. You 
could hear hollering 
from every single house... We went wild!"

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, look at this sushi! 
I even treated myself to the special 
deluxe platter!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm so glad I could bring 
good news to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
""Good" doesn't even begin to cover it. 
The moment you won, Tact... 
all those swirling worries just vanished 
into thin air."

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
"You gave us such immense strength... 
and unbelievable courage."

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! All the way to the finish 
line, 
our shoulders were tense as rocks... 
It truly felt like we were out there 
fighting alongside you."

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"You gave us the fighting spirit we 
needed, Tact. 
So we can keep pushing through until the 
day we can see you again!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... 
by autumn, you'll all be as strong 
as superheroes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because I... 
am going to become a Triple Tiara 
horsegirl.

title: After the Oka Sho: Overcoming the Mud
